reason: I know wheels, and I can usually find a decent used set on Marketplace for £150-200 and get it refinished myself. £280 for a seller nobody has vouched for feels like paying a refurb premium on faith. Viewing first and paying on collection is fair, but it doesn't make the price any lower.
objection: New seller, no reviews, and I can't tell if the refurb is proper or just paint over a bend. The photos could be of any set. Also, 'as available' means they might not have my PCD and offset anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A set that matches my car's exact PCD and offset, around £220, that I can see in person with the balancer report and tread depth shown. A few real buyers vouching for the seller would also help.
